operations.name: Single Employer
operations.description: Imagine a time when employees are happy to come to work and perform at their best while receiving prevailing wages and benefits including a retirement pension and the employer only pays 30% of the prevailing wage. Sounds too good? Not really. Through strategic investing by a single employer that rents out their staff to other employees at 30% of the prevailing wage, and the single employer investment returns pays the full salary with benefits and retirement to the employees. The employer-client can operate a fully staffed business at a fraction of the cost while removing the payroll dependency from the profits.

about: The founder has worked as a software development contractor during the majority of his career and while the compensation was above average, the projects and duration were unpredictable. Coupled with the founders successful background in currency trading provide employee leasing at a fraction of the cost to employers while offering prevailing wages with full benefits to the employees. The employers receive happier staff which translate to increase productivity and sales. The employees received consistent prevailing market wages with benefits that are not contingent on their employers profits.
